name: Fang of Vagash
summary: In Dun Morogh, Vagash threatens the breeders’ prized rams from the snowy crags. The Fang of Vagash proves the notorious marauding predator has been slain.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Vagash is a savage beast that stalks downhill from the ridges above Amberstill Ranch, often under cover of darkness, to slaughter prized rams. Dun Morogh’s high crags shelter bitter cold and fierce predators, but none have plagued the local ranches as Vagash has. Ironforge’s troops are stretched thin, leaving herdsmen without the city guard’s protection. A severed fang gives the breeders proof that Vagash is dead and the pasturelands are safe again.

faq.q: What is the Fang of Vagash used for?
aliases: what to do with fang of vagash
faq.answer: The fang is brought to the breeders at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh as proof that Vagash has been eliminated. The grateful ranchers reward the hunter who protected their livelihood.
Vagash is an unusually deadly beast that dens in the snowy hills above Dun Morogh’s ram pastures. He raids herds at night and has earned a fearsome reputation among local dwarves.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Ironforge guard killed Vagash?
faq.answer: Ironforge’s troops are already spread thin, with few soldiers to spare for rural patrols. The ranchers must rely on passing adventurers to deal with dangerous predators.

angles.text: Amberstill Ranch provides the hardy mountain rams essential to dwarven mountaineers and travelers. Bringing back Vagash’s fang helps preserve Ironforge’s most prized breed of mount.
Tracking an apex predator like Vagash through Dun Morogh’s freezing crags tests a hunter’s tracking, wilderness survival, and beast-slaying skills.
